death.title: Life cover

provisionLines.label: Retirement fund death benefits (net of tax)

notes: Income capital: 75% of after-tax income for 16 years, escalating at CPI and discounted at 7.0% p.a.

Retirement fund death benefits are allocated by the fund trustees under s37C of the Pension Funds Act (nominations are not binding) and can take up to 12 months; they are shown net of lump-sum tax and do not provide estate liquidity.

disability.title: Disability — lump sum
notes: Income replacement is addressed through income protection; the lump sum covers debt, lifestyle adaptations and lost employer retirement funding.
If income protection is not taken up, a further 6 532 157 lump sum would be needed to replace the income gap to age 65.

incomeProtection.title: Income protection
notes: Target: 100% of after-tax earned income. Insurers generally limit total income protection to about 100% of after-tax income.
Group income protection may be taxable if the employer owns the policy — confirm the tax treatment with the scheme.

severeIllness.title: Severe illness
notes: Some severe illness cover is accelerated — a claim reduces the life cover by the same amount.

funeral.title: Funeral

provisionLines.label: Life cover paying a nominee within days

notes: Bank accounts are frozen on death. Funeral policies and life cover with a nominated beneficiary pay quickly; group cover and estate proceeds can take weeks to months.
Accrual claim estimated from current net asset values less commencement values in the antenuptial contract.
An initial drawdown of 6.7% exceeds the ~4–5% generally regarded as sustainable for a living annuity.
Projection: 8.5% p.a. before and 7.5% p.a. after retirement, CPI 4.5%, contributions escalating at 5.5% p.a. Returns are not guaranteed.
